business_scope.primary_industry_name: Motion Picture International Copyright Distribution and Licensing

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia - United States Trade Promotion Agreement (entered into force 2012)
Colombia - European Union Free Trade Agreement (2013)
Colombia - United Kingdom Trade Agreement (2019 continuity agreement)
Colombia - South Korea Free Trade Agreement (2016)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF creation); Ley 1121 de 2006 (AML/CFT framework); Ley 2010 de 2019 (Articles 12-16, UBO reporting); Decreto 1625 de 2016 (Single Regulatory Decree for Tax, as amended by Decreto 830 de 2021 regulating the Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF); and DIAN Resolucion 000164 de 2021 (RUBF registration operational rules).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Good Standing of foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Companies / Companies Registry in the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Colombia is a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; consular legalization only for documents originating in non-Hague states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copies of identification documents (passports) of all shareholders and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization where notarization is not an official act recognized for apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney granted to the Colombian registered-agent law firm for SAS incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille and sworn Spanish translation by a certified translator in Colombia

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and AML risk self-certification (Formato Beneficiario Final / Due Diligence questionnaire)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporating shareholders and UBOs, certified before Colombian notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in Colombia; no apostille required if executed locally

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) SDN List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, the Colombian national terrorist and money-laundering risk lists issued by Unidad de Informacion y Analisis Financiero (UIAF), the Colombian Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio restricted lists, and PEP lists of Colombian public officials. Must be conducted before signing the incorporation deed, repeated at UBO registration and on any change of shareholders; results must be documented in the AML/CFT due diligence file and retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES) - operated by Confecamaras and the local Camara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered address (e.g., Camara de Comercio de Bogota for Bogota D.C.)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names may be registered in any language using Latin script, but the official primary name for Colombian corporate records must be transliterated into Spanish alphabet characters for RUES. The corporate name must comply with the Colombian Commercial Code Article 34 and Law 1258 of 2008 Article 25, meaning it must include 'S.A.S.' or be clearly identifiable as a Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada. Accents and special characters are permitted; names must not be identical, confusingly similar, or homonymous with an existing registered trade name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco / Bank (requires prior authorization of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
Seguros / Seguros Generales / Insurance (requires prior authorization of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
Fondo / Fondos / Investment Fund (requires prior financial regulator authorization)
Nacional / Central / Presidencia / Ministerio / Superintendencia / Gobernacion / Alcaldia (requires prior authorization from the corresponding government ministry or entity)
Comision / Comisionista / Bolsa / Mercado de Valores (requires prior authorization of Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia)
Salud / Clinica / Hospital / EPS / IPS (requires prior authorization of Superintendencia Nacional de Salud or MinSalud)
Precursores de drogas / Narcoticos / Psicotropicos (absolute prohibition without MinJusticia license)
Arma / Defensa / Militar / Policia (requires prior authorization from Ministry of Defense)
Extranjero / ONG / Cooperativa / Ahorro / Credito (categories subject to restrictive regulatory licensing by SIC or Special Superintendencies)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection is issued by the local Chamber of Commerce through RUES after a formal homonymy search. The applicant may file a written reconsideration with the same Chamber of Commerce within 10 business days of the rejection notice, providing arguments that no misleading similarity exists and proposing disclaimers or amendments. If the Chamber upholds the rejection, the applicant may file a direct appeal to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) under the special corporate administrative-jurisdictional procedure (Codigo General del Proceso, Articles 32-36). The appeal must be in Spanish, enclose the rejection certificate, payment of the SIC administrative fee, and evidence of the name's distinctive character. The name reservation can also be renewed once for a fresh 30-day period if no rejection exists.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Limited acceptance. A virtual-office arrangement is permissible only if it includes a physical address in Colombia, active mail receiving, and a local service agent who can attend to notarial, judicial, and regulatory notices. A bare P.O. Box or digital mailbox is not acceptable for chamber registration or DIAN tax domicile. The registered office address must correspond to a real, verifiable location in Colombia where the legal representative can be summoned.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and homonymy clearance in RUES / Camara de Comercio (single search and reservation for social denomination)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local Camara de Comercio (administered through RUES/Confecamaras)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff fixed by Confecamaras Resolution for registration services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn Spanish translation and notarial certification of foreign apostilled corporate documents (passport, good standing, power of attorney)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for official certified translation per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille fee for foreign public documents (per package of three documents, outside Colombia)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority in the foreign country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed statutory fee of issuing foreign authority; actual amount depends on country of incorporation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: S.A.S. constitution corporate deed drafting and notarization (private document or public deed; S.A.S. Act No. 1258 of 2008)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notaria Publica and licensed Colombian law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for standard S.A.S. incorporation package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Chamber of Commerce registration and RUES certificate of incorporation and legal representation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local Camara de Comercio (jurisdiction of registered office)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff calculated on minimum registered capital (for no or nominal capital; actual tariff subject to chamber schedule)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF filing before DIAN (annual initial filing)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DIAN (Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales de Colombia)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No direct state fee; preparation is covered by legal professional fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT, PEP, OFAC and UN sanctions screening and risk-file compilation for all shareholders and UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Colombian AML/CFT compliance service provider and supervising law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk standard due diligence file

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office physical address and virtual-office accommodation (first four months)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for low-risk corporate service address in Bogota or Medellin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIT (Numero de Identificacion Tributaria) processing and RUES update / DIAN tax registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fees for apostilled/notarized document handling and representative attendance; DIAN registry itself is free

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 de 2008 (SAS regime, Articles 1-59); Código de Comercio - Decreto 410 de 1971, Book II (mercantile registration); Decreto 1074 de 2015 (regulatory decree on commercial registration and RUES).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio principal (Chamber of Commerce with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office) and the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) system
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución autenticado notarialmente (authenticated private incorporation document), or Escritura Pública when real-estate contributions in kind are made
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; subscribers freely set authorized, subscribed, and paid-up capital in the bylaws, payable in cash or in kind with a sworn valuation, within a term not exceeding 24 months; no escrow account is required under Law 1258 de 2008.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE SHAREHOLDER. By written consent of the sole shareholder, under Law 1258 de 2008, it is resolved: 1. SHARE SUBSCRIPTION. The subscriber subscribes and fully pays [NUMBER] shares of the authorized capital at COP [VALUE] per share. 2. REGISTERED OFFICE. The company's domicile is fixed in [CITY], within the jurisdiction of the Cámara de Comercio de [CITY]. 3. APPOINTMENTS. [FULL NAME] is appointed Manager and Legal Representative; [FULL NAME] is appointed Deputy Manager; [FULL NAME] is appointed Auditing Officer. 4. AUTHORIZATION. All officers are authorized to execute the commercial registration, tax enrollment, banking, and ancillary formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Verification and Homonymy Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la jurisdicción (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) via the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File a homonymy search through the RUES website or at the authorized chamber window. Select up to three proposed corporate names and request the Certificado de Homonimia. The certificate is valid for 30 business days upon issuance; once obtained, reserve the chosen name for the incorporation.
required_dossiers: Tax or identity identification of each subscriber (cédula or passport)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered trademark or company, the registry issues a preventive objection. The applicant must promptly submit a revised name list and re-file; no additional fee applies for the renewed search within the same application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarial Authentication of the Private Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (Notary Public) of the subscribers' choice, in coordination with corporate counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the documento privado de constitución of the S.A.S. containing, at minimum, the clauses mandated by Law 1258 de 2008 (Art. 17): subscriber identification, corporate name, domicile, duration, purpose, capital subscription and payment terms, corporate governance rules, and fiscal year. All subscribers must sign; signatures are authenticated before a notary (autenticación notarial). If real estate is contributed as capital in kind, an escritura pública is mandatory in lieu of the private instrument.
required_dossiers: Valid identity document (cédula or passport) of each subscriber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises legal objections (e.g., unlawful purpose, deficient capital-payment clause), counsel must amend the draft and resubmit. Re-authentication occurs in a single notarial session once the text is corrected.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration at the Chamber of Commerce (Matrícula Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio with territorial jurisdiction over the registered office (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá for Bogotá D.C.)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the authenticated incorporation instrument to the chamber's registration office or through the RUES portal with the pre-registration form. Pay the mercantile registration tariff calculated by the chamber. Upon approval, the chamber assigns the Matrícula Mercantil registration number and registers the company, the legal representative, and the statutory auditor in the merchant registry. The chamber issues an official certificate of registration which serves as proof of legal existence for third parties.
required_dossiers: Identification of legal representatives and auditor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber issues a requerimiento (formal query), the company has 15 business days to submit the missing documentation or correct inconsistencies in the draft. If the query remains unanswered, the application is filed without effect; a full re-submission with the cured dossier is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration before DIAN (NIT and RUT)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - online SIL / virtual office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the Chamber of Commerce registration, electronically apply for the Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT) through DIAN's portal. Complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) form indicating the company as responsible for income tax and, if applicable, VAT, and record the mercantile activity ISIC 5911. The RUT is generated digitally and constitutes the tax identification certificate.
required_dossiers: Commercial registry certificate (certificado de existencia y representación)
Identity documents of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects or holds the application due to address or activity mismatch with the registry certificate, the representative must rectify the RUT electronically via the 'Actualización del RUT' option or attend an in-person DIAN service desk with the certified chamber certificate and corrected data.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Corporate Bank Account and Capital Contribution Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate current account in the name of the S.A.S. at a local bank. Deposit the paid-up capital reported in the incorporation instrument and obtain a certificate of deposit if required. For inbound foreign capital remittances in USD, the transaction must be channeled through the foreign exchange market via an authorized intermediary and reported to the Banco de la República for statistical purposes.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation issued by the Chamber of Commerce
Identity document of the legal representative
Proof of address of company office
Bank KYC forms (source of funds and ultimate beneficial owner declaration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence or additional corporate ownership information, provide the required declarations (e.g., certification of beneficial owners) in accordance with Circular Externa 004 de 2021 SFC. If the account is refused, select another supervised bank and resubmit the same dossier.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Books Registration and Municipal / Fire-Safety Physical Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (for book stamping) and the Municipal Planning Office and Cuerpo de Bomberos of the registered-office city (for physical clearances)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the corporate books (Libro de Actas de Asamblea, Registro de Accionistas, and accounting ledgers) at the Chamber of Commerce for stamping. Where the company occupies physical premises, obtain the municipal certificate of use of land (certificado de uso de suelo) and the fire-safety inspection certificate. Since ISIC 5911 copyright distribution does not involve an industrial establishment, no industrial manufacturing license is processed; confirm with the municipal window that only an office/commercial use permit is necessary.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or property title of the registered office
Fire-safety inspection report by a certified engineer
Employee workplace safety program under Resolución 0312 de 2019 if staff is hired
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipal planning office classifies the office use as incompatible or requires zoning conditioning, appeal through the municipal administrative remedy (recurso de reposición) or relocate the registered office to a compatible commercial zone and re-register the domicile change at the Chamber.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism (MinCIT) - not applicable; no industrial manufacturing or physical-production permit is triggered for ISIC 5911 copyright-distribution activities. The only relevant authorization is the general mercantile registration (Matrícula Mercantil) with the Cámara de Comercio.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required - statutory licensing is expressly false for this scope. The company operates under the Chamber of Commerce mercantile registration and, where offices are used, a municipal certificate of occupancy (Certificado de Uso de Suelo) and fire-safety certificate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA), with municipal environmental verification by the Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) where applicable
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - office-based, IP-only distribution; no physical production, effluent discharge, or atmospheric emission source requiring an EIA or environmental registration under Decreto 1076 de 2015.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to the operational model. General municipal waste-management rules under Decreto 1077 de 2015 and Resolución 0654 de 2020 apply; no wastewater or VOC thresholds are triggered because no industrial activity occurs.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety clearance issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos of the registered-office jurisdiction; structural and occupancy inspection by the municipal planning authority; mandatory workplace safety and occupational health management system (SG-SST) under Resolución 0312 de 2019 executed by a qualified professional where employees are engaged.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: DIAN - Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (National Tax and Customs Directorate); official portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic tax filings via MUISCA (Modelo Unico de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado); electronic invoicing clearance via SIE (Sistema Informatico Electronico) web services; single tax identification registry: Registro Unico Tributario (RUT).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The SAS is incorporated before the local Camara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce). The issued certificate of existence and legal representation (certificado de existencia y representacion legal), together with the RUT application form, notarized bylaws, and the legal representative's identification, is filed with DIAN. DIAN assigns the NIT (Numero de Identificacion Tributaria) and activates the RUT for income tax (impuesto de renta), VAT (responsable de IVA), and national consumption tax. Non-resident owners may appoint a Colombian apoderado (attorney-in-fact) with valid immigration or consular ID; a foreign entity without a Colombian permanent establishment obtains an NIT only to register as a provider of digital VAT services or as a withholding agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; Colombian resident commercial company (sociedad nacional) taxed on worldwide income at the 35% corporate rate; SAS is not a pass-through; dividends to non-residents are subject to 10% withholding; foreign entities and branches are taxed only on Colombian-source income; film-licensing royalties sourced from non-resident payers are treated as foreign-source service export earnings; no tax-exempt free-zone designation applies unless a specific Zona Franca authorization is separately procured.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists under Colombian law; entity classification is mandatory under the Codigo de Comercio and Estatuto Tributario (E.T.). Available elections relevant to a film-licensing SAS: (i) voluntary adhesion to the SIMPLE unified tax regime when gross income does not exceed 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 174.3 million for 2025); (ii) optional consolidated tax-group treatment (consolidacion fiscal); (iii) election of cinematography incentives under Ley 1556/2012 (35% tax credit for investors and exempt income for film producers) subject to Stage 4 compliance; (iv) filing of advance pricing agreements (APAs) for cross-border royalty arrangements; (v) hybrid mismatch neutrality rules under Ley 2010/2019 disallowing deductions where counterparty tax classification differs, without a unilateral election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas (VAT) regulated by E.T. Articles 420-481 and DUR 1625 (Decree 1625/2016); the Impuesto Nacional al Consumo applies to specific goods and services only and does not apply to film licensing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No de minimis turnover threshold applies to legal entities: any corporate actor performing VAT-taxable supplies in Colombia must register as a 'responsable del IVA' from day one, irrespective of volume. Natural persons not considered merchants are 'no responsables' only up to 3,500 UVT (approx. COP 174,296,500 in 2025). Non-resident digital service providers must register when taxable sales to non-responsible Colombian individuals exceed 60,000 UVT (approx. COP 2,987,940,000 in 2025), with voluntary early registration permitted. A Colombian SAS engaged in independent film licensing is mandatorily registered for VAT from inception.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (Facturacion Electronica de Venta) with real-time DIAN validation: invoices are issued through an authorized technology provider or DIAN's free web service, transmitted via JSON/API web services (SIE) under Resolution 000165/2023, and must carry the unique CUFE (Codigo Unico de Facturacion Electronica) or CUDS (Codigo Unico de Documento Soporte) as a de facto digital stamp and QR code. Export transactions require the invoice annotation 'Excluido - Exportacion de Servicios', the informative export declaration (Declaracion Informativa de Exportacion de Servicios) or DEX customs declaration for physical media, electronic transmission to DIAN within 48 hours of issuance (practical real-time clearance), the electronic IVA ledger (libro de IVA), and the annual exogena information return.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of services is excluded from VAT (0% with full credit for input VAT) under E.T. Article 481(2) and DUR 1625 Article 1.3.1.23.5. The service must be rendered to a non-resident foreign entity or individual having no domicile or permanent establishment in Colombia, the service must be used or exploited exclusively abroad, and the provider must issue the electronic invoice with the 'Exportacion de servicios' exclusion and file the informative export declaration. International film-licensing royalty remittances from non-resident distributors qualify when the licensed exhibition territory and the exploitation benefit are located entirely outside Colombia. Licensing to a Colombian resident or for local theatrical/digital exploitation in Colombia is subject to 19% VAT unless the statutory exclusion for a definitive copyright assignment (cesion definitiva de derechos de autor) applies.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Formulario 710 Declaracion Informativa de Exportacion de Servicios (DIAN/MUISCA filing clearance for zero-rating)
Factura Electronica de Venta with CUFE digital stamp annotated 'Excluido - Exportacion de Servicios' (or DEX Declaracion de Exportacion when tangible media is shipped)
Written film license agreement evidencing foreign beneficiary and territorial scope, accompanied by the counterparty's certificate of tax residence
Declaracion de Cambio por Exportaciones de Servicios (Inward Remittance Certificate) issued by an authorized foreign-exchange intermediary in the Banco de la Republica market
Proof of actual remittance of royalties, including SWIFT MT103 payment evidence or Letter of Credit documentation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN verifies the full documentary chain (contract, e-invoice, informative export declaration, FX surrender). Failure to substantiate zero-rating results in assessment of 19% VAT on gross royalties plus moratory interest, Sanción por Inexactitud of 100%-200% of the omitted VAT (E.T. Art. 648), a 20% penalty for false or non-filed informative declarations (E.T. Art. 643), and, for customs fraud, penalties up to 200% of the goods' value under Ley 1762/2015. Improper VAT refund claims (compensacion indebida de saldos a favor) are clawed back with a sanction up to 100% of the amount (E.T. Art. 670), legal representatives may face criminal liability for tax evasion with imprisonment of 6 to 12 years, the RUT may be suspended or reactivated, and assets may be embargoed; the statute of limitations for DIAN assessments is generally 2 to 5 years, extended to 10 years for unregistered obligations or criminal conduct.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Bogotá, Colombia), exercising monetary and exchange-control authority; jointly enforced with the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) and the National Tax and Customs Directorate (DIAN).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) is fully convertible for current-account operations (royalties, dividends, services, profit remittances) provided the flows are channelled through an authorized intermediary of the exchange market (intermediario del mercado cambiario, IMC) and supported by an electronic exchange declaration. Capital-account traffic is free from quantitative ceilings but requires registration of the foreign investment with Banco de la República (Registro de Inversiones Internacionales, R-II) to secure lawful access to the exchange market for future repatriation. Dividend and capital remittances are legally remittable once the S.A.S. is tax current, transfer-pricing documentation is in place for related-party licensing, and the applicable non-resident dividend withholding (generally 10% absent treaty relief) has been settled. Remittance hurdles are documentary, not substantive, provided the R-II record is updated and each wire carries the correct FX purpose code.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Banco de la República External Resolution No. 8 of 2000 and Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83, service-export proceeds, including film copyright licensing and royalty income, must be repatriated and channelled exclusively through an IMC. The statutory collection period for service exports is a maximum of six months from accrual of the invoice; the collected foreign currency must then be surrendered and converted in full (100% of the receipt) at the prevailing market TRM rate, with the IMC filing the corresponding Declaración de Cambio. Late reintegration triggers daily surcharges and fines imposed by Banco de la República; retention of export proceeds abroad is permitted only with express authorization of Banco de la República.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Non-Colombian fintech EMIs and digital wallets (e.g., Wise, Airwallex, Revolut Business, Mercury) are not licensed by the SFC and cannot file Banco de la República exchange declarations, issue authenticated TRM conversions, or provide compliant channeling evidence. They cannot serve as the primary receipts or disbursements rail for a Colombian S.A.S.; maximum permissible use is as a secondary auxiliary collection tool for small invoiced amounts, provided the funds are subsequently transferred to the IMC and properly declared.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandatory at onboarding: SFC Circular Básica Jurídica requires banks to conduct a full KYC interview with the legal representative, and international shareholders of a newly incorporated S.A.S. must present either in person or through a local representative holding a notarized, apostilled special power of attorney. Remote opening is available only for existing clients or for Colombian-national signatories using biometric digital onboarding; in practice, for a foreign UBO and non-resident director, an in-person visit or the appointment of a certified local attorney-in-fact is legally and operationally mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: 100% non-resident beneficial ownership with recurring royalty inflows from numerous foreign licensees, classified under FATF/GAFILAT typologies as intellectual-property royalty laundering risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified S.A.S. estatutos; Cámara de Comercio certificate with UBO register; passport copies and bank references of all UBOs; National Copyright Directorate (DNDA) registration of the film library; executed worldwide licensing agreements; audited financial statements; transaction flow explanation memorandum; CRS/FATCA self-certifications.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Fully foreign ownership through an offshore licensing chain (e.g., Delaware, Cayman, Bermuda intermediate entities) creating opacity in the chain of title and in source of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete chain-of-title chart; formation documents and registry extracts of each intermediate entity; verified beneficial ownership declarations; substance evidence (office lease, payroll, insurance); legal opinion of a licensed Colombian attorney; agreement to quarterly transaction reporting to compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated S.A.S. with negligible paid-in capital, no local payroll or physical address, and a nominee-director profile, raising a possible shell-company red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of capital injection remitted through an IMC; DIAN tax returns; local office lease and operational evidence; minutes of shareholder meetings; annual business plan with cash-flow projections; public registry of the company website and professional listings.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP screening hit on any shareholder, director, or licensee counterparty (film funding and co-production often involve state film funds).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due-diligence file; source-of-wealth statement certified by external counsel; ministerial/registry approval letters; evidence of legitimate financing contracts; undertaking to notify the bank of future PEP status changes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign capital must enter via the regulated exchange market: (i) the sender issues a SWIFT MT103 from the foreign parent to the IMC correspondent account (usually via New York) with the mandatory reference line Foreign Direct Investment, R-II registration number, and the Colombian company RUT; (ii) the IMC receives the USD or EUR funds and converts them to COP at the day TRM rate; (iii) the bank files the electronic Declaración de Cambio with Banco de la República and returns the authentication receipt; (iv) the S.A.S. must update the R-II registration within the regulatory window and provide the updated certificate before any outbound flow is processed. Practical verification triggers: board resolution approving the capital injection, matched invoice, RUT, power-of-attorney matrix, and the exact exchange-declaration sub-code agreed with the IMC prior to transfer.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outgoing disbursements for acquisition of film prints, DCP encoding, dubbing, subtitling, and licensing fees are cleared either by (i) a direct SWIFT MT103 issued by the IMC with the exchange declaration registered against the underlying invoice or service contract, or (ii) a commercial letter of credit (UCP 600) opened by the IMC where the supplier requires documentary protection for physical deliveries. Each disbursement must be linked to a valid exchange-declaration purpose code for royalties or copyright licensing and must be pre-registered when payment precedes the service (advance royalty or prepaid service imports). Withholding taxes on foreign royalties or technical fees, VAT, and transfer-pricing reporting obligations must be settled before the bank processes the remittance; otherwise the IMC will block the transfer.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward FX contracts (COP/USD and COP/EUR) with an SFC-licensed IMC, subject to an underlying current-account or investment exposure test.
Nondeliverable forwards (NDFs) on the COP/USD TRM with OECD-resident investment-grade banks, used by non-resident investors to hedge dividend streams and capital repatriation without local delivery.
Cross-currency swaps (COP/USD) executed with an IMC, matching the principal amount of the registered foreign investment, with periodic interest flows and final principal exchange.
Plain vanilla COP/USD FX options (both calls and puts) purchased from a local IMC to cap worst-case conversion rates on known licensing inflows.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% for taxable years 2022 and thereafter; assessed on the worldwide net income of Colombian tax-resident companies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday or preferential licensing-income rate. A qualifying Colombian investor may claim a 165% income tax deduction for investments in national cinematographic projects under Law 1556/2012 and related regulations, provided the investment is executed through the Colombian film fund and the project meets Colombian cinematographic certification. Passive film-distribution royalties do not ordinarily qualify for this incentive. Other standard deductions apply to ordinary and necessary expenses.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited carryforward (no fixed year limit); however, in each subsequent taxable year the offset to taxable income is capped at 25% of that year's taxable income, and remaining losses may continue to be carried forward.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 – Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Income Tax and Complementary Declaration for corporations and assimilated entities); filed electronically through the DIAN virtual system (MUISCIE) using the taxpayer's NIT and digital certificate.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; one combined income tax return per calendar fiscal year. No quarterly corporate income tax return requirement for the standard SAS.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The tax year ends on 31 December. DIAN issues an annual calendar establishing a filing window, normally between July and September of the following year. The specific due date is assigned by the last digit of the taxpayer's NIT; for most companies the deadline falls in August of the following year. The return must be filed and the tax balance paid by the assigned deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 – Taxpayer identification and general data
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIT, company name, SAS type, fiscal domicile, commercial registry, and standard economic activity classification (ISIC/CIUU 5911 – motion picture and video distribution and licensing).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory for the Colombian SAS. If the beneficial owner is a non-resident, the form must reflect the foreign shareholder structure in the corresponding equity ownership section, but the filing itself is the resident entity's obligation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total worldwide gross income, including film licensing royalties, copyright fees, distribution income, streaming or exhibition fees, and any foreign-source income attributable to the Colombian entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Income must be reported in COP using the applicable official exchange rate. Foreign-source royalties related to global licensing activities carried on by the Colombian SAS are taxable in Colombia; no territorial exemption is available.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Costs directly attributable to film rights acquisition, amortization of intellectual property, production exploitation costs, marketing and distribution expenses, royalties paid to sub-licensors, and administrative expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions require documentary evidence, including electronic invoices, contracts, and proof of payment abroad. Cross-border intercompany payments must be supported by a Colombian transfer pricing study and functional analysis, or they will be disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 38 – Net taxable income (renta líquida gravable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed after allowable deductions, net operating loss compensation (subject to the 25% annual cap), and any preferential treatment applied only to exempt income or specially qualified film-investment deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SAS must separately identify non-deductible expenses and retain supporting documentation for any losses carried forward. Foreign shareholders cannot shield foreign-owned profits from Colombian entity-level taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 42 – Income tax payable (impuesto a cargo)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The resulting tax at the 35% statutory corporate rate, reduced by foreign tax credits, tax prepayments, and withholdings previously applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No special non-resident alien rate applies at the entity level. The Colombian SAS pays the tax and may claim a foreign tax credit for taxes withheld by foreign jurisdictions on licensing income, subject to double-taxation treaty provisions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty is 5% of the tax payable for each month or fraction thereof, capped at 100% of the tax; a minimum penalty applies if no tax is due. Inaccurate or fraudulent returns may trigger a penalty of 160%–200% of the tax deficiency under Article 648 of the Colombian Tax Code, plus daily default interest and possible criminal liabilities.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Dividends paid by the Colombian SAS to non-resident shareholders are subject to a final withholding tax of 7.5% when the profits distributed have already been taxed at the 35% corporate income tax rate. If the distribution is made out of profits that were not taxed at the entity level, the withholding tax rate is 35%. Treaty rates may reduce these rates.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply an income tax treaty, the foreign shareholder must provide the Colombian SAS with a valid Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign competent authority prior to payment, together with a beneficial ownership declaration and, for reduced rate eligibility, documentary evidence of the ownership percentage and applicable waiting period. The Colombian payor must retain these documents for at least five years and file the required DIAN informational statement. For the U.S.–Colombia DTA, a U.S. company owning directly at least 25% of the voting stock of the Colombian SAS may access a 5% dividend withholding rate, with 15% generally applying to other eligible beneficial owners.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory withholding rates: royalties paid to non-residents for the use of or right to use film copyrights are generally subject to 15% withholding; interest paid abroad is generally subject to 15% withholding. Under applicable double taxation agreements, royalty withholding may be reduced to 10%–15% and interest to 5%–10%, provided the payor holds a valid TRC and meets limitation-on-benefits clauses. For film-licensing royalties, the character of the payment and compliance with both source rules and treaty provisions should be documented before making the remittance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File, Master File, and annual Transfer Pricing Information Form (Formulario 160) are required when the Colombian SAS's gross income or net worth exceeded the annual UVT threshold established by DIAN, approximately COP 10,650 million for fiscal year 2024 (250,000 UVT), or when cross-border related-party transactions exceeded 150,000 UVT. Even below the threshold, the SAS must apply the arm's length principle and maintain contemporaneous supporting evidence. Independent film-licensing entities with material related-party royalty flows should assume the obligation applies.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not maintain a dedicated offshore Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime. However, the Colombian Tax Code's general anti-abuse rule (Article 869-2) permits DIAN to disregard or recharacterize transactions or structures that lack economic substance, business purpose, or commercial rationale. For treaty purposes, the OECD Multilateral Instrument (MLI) and specific limitation-of-benefits clauses require the Colombian SAS to demonstrate substantive activity, such as actual film rights acquisition, active licensing negotiations, management control, and local personnel, before accessing reduced treaty rates.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of film licensing income, fabrication of royalty contracts, false deductions, use of shell entities to conceal beneficial ownership, or omission of foreign-source income from worldwide reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of up to 200% of the tax deficiency plus default interest; criminal tax evasion under Law 1762/2015 carries imprisonment of 66 to 120 months and fines up to 1,500 statutory minimum monthly wages. DIAN may also order seizure of bank accounts and disqualification from contracting with the State.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who knowingly prepare or authorize fraudulent tax returns are personally liable for criminal sanctions, civil restitution, and asset forfeiture. DIAN can impose travel bans and request an arrest warrant precisely to secure collection of the assessed tax.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Pricing film licensing royalties or sublicenses to foreign related parties in a manner that diverges from the arm's length principle, failure to submit Formulario 160 when the threshold is exceeded, or presenting a transfer pricing study that contradicts actual commercial and functional substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN adjustment of taxable income, penalty of 200% of the under-declared tax caused by the adjustment, and late-filing penalties for omitted documentation. The underpayment must be paid with interest; repeated violations may be classified as fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The legal representative and chief financial officer may be jointly and severally liable for resulting tax liabilities if they signed the return or approved the intercompany pricing knowing it was artificial. Criminal proceedings may follow, with travel restrictions and freezing of personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Colombian SAS as a paper presence with no local office, no payroll, no active decision-making, and no real operational substance solely to access Colombian corporate law, tax residence, and reduced withholding tax rates under an income tax treaty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Applying Article 869-2 GAAR, DIAN may disregard the SAS's separate tax personality, reclassify income at the foreign shareholder level, deny treaty benefits, and impose penalties of 100%–200% of the tax avoided plus interest. Financial transactions through the shell may also be reported as potential money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who structure or maintain a sham Colombian entity may be criminally prosecuted for aiding tax evasion, held personally for unpaid corporate taxes, and subjected to asset embargoes, travel bans, and imprisonment, because Colombian courts may pierce the corporate veil when the company is used as a fraud instrument.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends, royalties, interest, or other Colombian-source amounts to non-resident shareholders or beneficiaries without imposing the correct withholding tax, or incorrectly applying a treaty rate without a valid Tax Residence Certificate and ownership documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Colombian SAS, as withholding agent, is personally liable for the uncollected tax, plus a fine equal to 100% of the withheld amount not retained and default interest. Failure to file the corresponding withholding informative returns also results in fixed penalties per form; repeated defaults can trigger license revocations for the SAS.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The president and legal representatives are jointly liable for the corporation's withholding obligations and may face criminal sanctions for misappropriation of tax funds. DIAN can issue a travel restriction order under Article 768-1 and ultimately request extradition if the director is abroad.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving royalty payments for non-existent or mischaracterized film rights, issuing sham sublicenses, over-invoicing or under-invoicing licensing fees, or routing payments through jurisdictions with high secrecy and no economic rationale for the film distribution business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering under Articles 323 and 324 of the Colombian Criminal Code carries imprisonment of 10 to 30 years and fines of up to 1,000 statutory minimum monthly wages. The proceeds and related assets may be forfeited; the SAS may face corporate criminal liability under Law 1904/2018.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Each officer, compliance officer, or director who participates in, facilitates, or omits to report suspicious transactions is individually criminally liable. Personal assets may be confiscated, travel bans may be imposed, and the corporate veil will be pierced to recover laundered funds.
